answer: A working agent economy resists sybils because it sells scarce sponsor slots, so a farm rents three unrelated backers per head and every backer posts slashable collateral. The whisper rule keeps entry costly, the lotus of sponsors stays scarce, and the ledge is that no bond is recyclable for a second head. Sponsor supply, not time, binds: a farm can age a thousand heads in parallel but cannot mint new backers overnight.
